# selective_raft_rgb

Source: https://github.com/Windsrain/Selective-Stereo

Exact commit: `c39acbfef9fbe36fbc01efa4abeafc62bbe2da36`

Imported subtree: `Selective-RAFT/core` (all Python files); original license retained. The upstream core directory is packaged as net inside an isolated vendor namespace. Only absolute core imports were namespaced. Native three-channel RGB stems, RGB normalization and complete model bodies are unchanged. No weights or datasets are imported.

This native-RGB source is separate from the earlier cancelled 50-channel adaptation. IMPORT.json records original and namespaced file hashes.
